comment: A5 Round 24 — device message / key verification / key backup negative vectors. Spec authority: extensions/device-messages.md + crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md (encrypted-envelope shape) + authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md §B-22 (strict key_ref violations on encrypted envelopes). The negative vectors below cover: (a) malformed encrypted-envelope key_ref (B-22 strict_key_ref violation: key_ref not present in trust set, or stale, or wrong-DID-namespace); (b) unauthorized sender — the sending device's `device.authorized` content.scopes does NOT include the device-message scope; (c) expired session_grant proof; (d) replay-window violation (same envelope_id seen within the dedup window). All vectors MUST reject closed; encrypted envelope is opaque ciphertext but the OUTER frame fields (sender_device_id, recipient_device_id, key_ref, envelope_id, hlc, session_grant_proof) are validated by the recipient before any decryption is attempted.

encoder.envelope_shape: { envelope_id, sender_device_id, recipient_device_id, key_ref, hlc, session_grant_proof, ciphertext_b64 }

negative_vectors.name: key_ref_not_in_trust_set_b22_violation
negative_vectors.comment: B-22 strict_key_ref: recipient's key_ref trust-set is built from the sender's most-recent device.authorized.cell active tags. If the envelope's key_ref does NOT appear in that trust-set (e.g. an attacker forged a signing key not yet authorized) the recipient MUST reject the envelope BEFORE attempting decryption. Reason: key_ref_not_authorized.

expected.rationale: B-22: declared key_ref outside the sender's authorized trust set. Reject pre-decryption.

negative_vectors.name: key_ref_wrong_did_namespace_b22_violation
negative_vectors.comment: B-22 strict_key_ref: key_ref's DID prefix MUST match sender_device_id's DID. An envelope claiming to be from Alice but signed under Bob's DID-namespace key MUST reject as cross-actor key reuse.

expected.rationale: B-22: key_ref DID-prefix did:ck:dev:dev_carol_01 does NOT match sender_device_id did:ck:dev:dev_alice_01. Cross-actor key reuse forbidden.

negative_vectors.name: unauthorized_sender_scope_mismatch
negative_vectors.comment: Sender device's `device.authorized` content.scopes set does NOT include `device_messages.send`. Even though the envelope key_ref IS in trust set, the sending device is not authorized for this scope.

expected.rationale: device.authorized.content.scopes lacks device_messages.send; even with valid key_ref the sender is not authorized for this content.

negative_vectors.name: expired_session_grant_proof
negative_vectors.comment: session_grant_proof.expires_at < now (recv_time). Recipient MUST reject expired grants pre-decryption.

negative_vectors.name: replay_window_duplicate_envelope_id
negative_vectors.comment: Recipient maintains a dedup cache keyed by envelope_id within a replay window (300s default). A second envelope with the same envelope_id MUST reject; the first delivery is canonical.

expected.rationale: envelope_id already seen within replay window (300s); duplicate delivery is dropped.

negative_vectors.name: key_ref_stale_b22_violation
negative_vectors.comment: B-22 strict_key_ref: key_ref points to a leaf that has been ROTATED OUT (no longer in trust_set; was revoked by a later cx.device.revoke Move). The envelope is technically signed but cryptographically stale — must reject.

expected.rationale: B-22 strict_key_ref: key_ref refers to a leaf rotated out of trust set; reject pre-decryption.
